domain.description: Business or technical domain (e.g., Commerce, Payments)

client.description: Client or customer name for this architecture

VTEXAccounts.description: VTEX account names associated with this architecture

environments.description: List of environments defined for this architecture. Node environment property must reference one of these by id.

validatedAgainst.description: Atlas Core Model or rule set version used for validation

description.description: Optional contextual description of the architecture

commerce.description: E-commerce business context for this architecture. Drives Atlas validation rules and architecture classification.
E-commerce business context metadata. All properties are optional to allow incremental adoption.

businessModel.description: One or more business models covered by this architecture. Array allows mixed implementations (e.g. B2B + B2C on same platform).

accountType.description: VTEX account topology. 'Standard' = single merchant. 'Marketplace' = this architecture covers the marketplace account and all its sellers.

sellerType.description: Types of sellers present. Only relevant when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

multiAccount.description: True when the implementation spans multiple VTEX accounts (e.g. franchise networks, sub-accounts per region).

marketplace.description: Marketplace governance rules. Required when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

channels.description: Customer-facing sales and interaction channels covered by this architecture.

cdn.description: CDN provider used for storefront delivery.

multiLanguage.description: True when the implementation serves content in more than one language. Implies catalog translation and CMS localisation requirements.

multiCurrency.description: True when the implementation supports more than one currency. Implies pricing and checkout currency-switching architecture.

tradePolicies.description: Number of VTEX trade policies configured in this architecture. Relevant for multi-region, multi-segment, and franchise architectures.

searchProvider.description: Search and discovery engine in use.

catalogSource.description: System of record for product catalog data.

hasPricePerCustomer.description: True when customer-specific or contract-based pricing is in use (B2B price tables, PROS integration, etc.).

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods and gateways integrated. Free-form strings to accommodate the full vendor landscape.

antiFraud.description: Anti-fraud provider integrated with VTEX Payment Hub.

paymentSplitModel.description: Payment split/intermediation model. Only relevant when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

hasSubscriptions.description: True when VTEX Subscriptions or equivalent recurring order flow is implemented.

hasGiftCard.description: True when gift card as a payment method or product is part of the architecture.

hasLoyalty.description: True when a loyalty or points programme is integrated (e.g. Zinrelo, custom, VTEX native).

hasCustomerCredit.description: True when VTEX Customer Credit or an equivalent charge-account/net-terms payment flow is implemented.

omsProvider.description: Order management system. Use 'External' when VTEX OMS is bypassed in favour of a third-party OMS.

fulfillmentModel.description: Fulfilment strategies covered by this architecture.

hasReturnsFlow.description: True when a returns flow (VTEX Returns App or custom) is part of the architecture.

multiWarehouse.description: True when inventory spans multiple warehouses or fulfilment centres.

hasStorePickup.description: True when click-and-collect / BOPIS is supported.

hasSameDayDelivery.description: True when same-day delivery via a last-mile partner (e.g. Uber, Instacart) is part of the architecture.

hasOrderReconciliation.description: True when a financial order reconciliation flow between marketplace and sellers exists.

erp.description: ERP system integrated with VTEX (free-form to accommodate the full vendor landscape, e.g. SAP, Oracle EBS, Linx).

wms.description: Warehouse management system integrated with VTEX (e.g. Korber, custom).

pim.description: Product information management system used as catalog source (e.g. Salsify, Stibo, Akeneo).

crm.description: CRM system integrated for customer data (e.g. Salesforce, Oracle CX).

identityProvider.description: Identity / SSO provider used alongside VTEX ID.

dataWarehouse.description: Data warehouse or lakehouse receiving VTEX data (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery).

cdpOrPersonalization.description: Customer data platform or personalisation tools integrated (e.g. Adobe Target, Criteo, Segment).

hasDataPipeline.description: True when VTEX Data Pipeline is explicitly configured for data export.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes covered by this architecture.

language.description: BCP 47 language tags for the locales supported (e.g. en-US, pt-BR, es-CO).

marketplaceGovernance.description: Governance rules defining ownership responsibilities between the marketplace operator and its sellers. Required when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

priceOwnership.description: Who sets the final consumer price. 'Marketplace' = operator controls all prices. 'Seller' = each seller controls their own prices. 'Hybrid' = mix of both (e.g. operator sets floor, seller sets final).

paymentOwnership.description: Who processes the payment transaction. 'Marketplace' = operator collects and remits to sellers. 'Seller' = each seller processes their own payments independently. 'Split' = marketplace collects and performs automated payment split.

catalogOwnership.description: Who owns the product catalog master data. 'Marketplace' = operator owns and sellers inherit. 'Seller' = sellers manage their own SKUs. 'Shared' = catalog matcher used to map seller SKUs to marketplace catalog.

fulfillmentOwnership.description: Who is responsible for order fulfilment logistics.

sellerOnboarding.description: How sellers are onboarded onto the marketplace.

nodeRef.description: Reference to a node by its id

dataEntityRef.description: Reference to a dataEntity by its id

environmentRef.description: Reference to an environment by its id

environment.description: Reference to the runtime environment (by id) where the node runs. Must reference one of the environments defined in architecture.environments.

implementation.description: Whether the node is a native (out-of-the-box) or custom implementation

timing.description: Whether the flow is real-time (synchronous) or asynchronous

examplePayload.description: Serialized JSON example or structured payload example

constraints.description: Hierarchy and relationship constraints. Applications should validate that node parent-child relationships conform to these rules.

hierarchy.description: Defines allowed child node types for each parent node type. Each property name is a parent node type, and its value is an array of allowed child node types. Applications must validate that nodes respect these hierarchy rules.
